l4_steps.name: Capture data source requirements from business
l4_steps.input: Business analytics request or new system onboarding
l4_steps.output: Data source specification document with SLA and refresh frequency
l4_steps.kpi: Requirements captured within 5 business days of request; ≥90% completeness score
l4_steps.pain_point: Airline ops systems (Amadeus Altéa, Jeppesen) use proprietary APIs with limited documentation, causing specification rework

l4_steps.name: Assess source API availability and schema
l4_steps.output: Schema discovery report; connector feasibility assessment
l4_steps.kpi: Schema discovery completed within 2 days; 100% of fields documented
l4_steps.pain_point: PSS and crew management systems use batch SFTP exports rather than real-time APIs, creating up to 24-hour data latency for operational dashboards

l4_steps.name: Configure AWS Glue ETL connectors
l4_steps.input: Schema discovery report; source credentials in AWS Secrets Manager
l4_steps.output: Parameterised Glue job with incremental load logic
l4_steps.kpi: Connector build time ≤3 days; incremental load latency ≤15 min for streaming sources
l4_steps.pain_point: GDS feed formats (Sabre, Travelport) change without advance notice, breaking Glue jobs and requiring emergency patching during revenue-critical periods

l4_steps.name: Ingest raw data to S3 landing zone
l4_steps.input: Source system data via Glue job or Kinesis Data Streams
l4_steps.output: Raw partitioned Parquet files in S3 landing zone with ingestion timestamp
l4_steps.kpi: Pipeline success rate ≥99.5% per month; P99 ingestion latency ≤30 min
l4_steps.pain_point: Amadeus Altéa PNR change events generate burst loads during irregular operations (IROPs), overwhelming Kinesis shards and causing data loss if auto-scaling is not pre-configured

l4_steps.name: Execute automated data quality checks
l4_steps.input: Raw data files in S3 landing zone
l4_steps.output: DQ scorecard with row counts, null rates, freshness, schema drift alerts
l4_steps.kpi: DQ check coverage ≥95% of all active datasets; anomaly detection P95 latency ≤10 min
l4_steps.pain_point: Flight operations feeds contain mission-critical fields (flight status, delay codes) where a single null cascades into incorrect OTP reporting to DOT, creating regulatory exposure

l4_steps.name: Quarantine and triage DQ failures
l4_steps.input: DQ failure alert from Monte Carlo
l4_steps.output: Quarantine record in S3 rejected zone; Jira ticket auto-created for source team
l4_steps.kpi: P1 DQ incidents triaged within 1 hour; resolution SLA ≤4 hours for operational data domains
l4_steps.pain_point: Crew system data gaps post-irregular ops (mirrors Dec 2022 SkySolver failure pattern) create silent DQ failures where crew assignment data appears complete but contains stale records

l4_steps.name: Register and classify dataset in data catalog
l4_steps.output: Catalog entry with business glossary linkage, data owner, lineage graph, and retention policy
l4_steps.kpi: 100% of production datasets catalogued within 1 sprint of go-live; lineage coverage ≥80% of governed domains
l4_steps.pain_point: High analyst turnover means undocumented datasets proliferate; teams build duplicate pipelines for the same source, wasting engineering capacity and creating inconsistent metrics

l4_steps.name: Apply PII masking and access controls
l4_steps.input: Dataset classification from Collibra; GDPR/CCPA data subject inventory
l4_steps.output: Masked/tokenised dataset in governed S3 zone; IAM policy attached to dataset
l4_steps.kpi: PII detection coverage ≥99% of passenger-facing domains; zero unmasked PII in non-production environments
l4_steps.pain_point: Rapid Rewards member data flows through multiple systems (Altéa, Redshift, Tableau); inconsistent masking across environments has previously caused PII exposure in analytics sandboxes

l4_steps.name: Develop dbt transformation models
l4_steps.input: Governed raw data in S3; dimensional modelling spec from data product owner
l4_steps.output: dbt models (staging → intermediate → mart layers); compiled SQL lineage DAG
l4_steps.kpi: dbt model test pass rate ≥98%; model execution time within agreed SLA per domain (e.g. revenue mart ≤20 min)
l4_steps.pain_point: Fare and revenue data from ATPCO and Amadeus NRM use airline-specific tariff codes that require complex lookup logic; errors in fare basis decoding produce materially wrong yield reports

l4_steps.name: Run dbt model tests and schema validation
l4_steps.output: Test results report; row count reconciliation against source
l4_steps.kpi: Zero undetected primary-key duplicates in mart layer; row count variance ≤0.1% vs source
l4_steps.pain_point: Amadeus SkyWORKS schedule changes (flight adds/cancels) generate late-arriving facts that cause mart row count mismatches, failing dbt tests and blocking downstream dashboards

l4_steps.name: Load transformed data to Redshift data warehouse
l4_steps.input: Validated dbt mart tables in S3; COPY manifest
l4_steps.output: Populated Redshift dimensional schema with distribution and sort keys optimised
l4_steps.kpi: Load job SLA: ≤60 min for daily full refresh; query P90 response time ≤5 s on standard analyst workloads
l4_steps.pain_point: Redshift cluster concurrency limits cause query queuing during peak morning reporting windows (06:00–09:00 local), when ops, revenue, and finance teams all run simultaneous heavy queries

l4_steps.name: Design and build Tableau analytics dashboards
l4_steps.input: Redshift mart tables; stakeholder wireframe sign-off
l4_steps.output: Tableau workbook with certified data source and row-level security filters
l4_steps.kpi: Dashboard load time ≤8 s on standard extract; certified data source reuse rate ≥60% across dashboards
l4_steps.pain_point: Business users bypass certified data sources and connect directly to raw Redshift tables, creating metric discrepancies between dashboards and eroding trust in analytics outputs

l4_steps.name: Obtain stakeholder sign-off on dashboard accuracy
l4_steps.input: Published Tableau dashboard (UAT environment); reconciliation against source system report
l4_steps.output: Signed acceptance document; dashboard promoted to production Tableau Server
l4_steps.kpi: UAT cycle ≤5 business days; zero P1 metric errors post-production release
l4_steps.pain_point: Revenue management teams use Amadeus NRM as system of record for yield metrics; divergence between NRM native reports and Tableau (caused by time-zone offsets in fact tables) leads to sign-off delays

l4_steps.name: Publish self-service data products to analytics portal
l4_steps.input: Certified Tableau dashboards; approved dbt mart definitions
l4_steps.output: Published data product with SLA, owner, lineage, and Collibra catalog linkage
l4_steps.kpi: Data product NPS ≥7/10 in quarterly survey; product adoption ≥80% of target business unit within 30 days of launch
l4_steps.pain_point: Lack of a self-service data marketplace means analyst requests are routed to the data engineering backlog, creating queue times of 4–8 weeks for straightforward data access needs

l4_steps.name: Monitor pipeline health and SLA compliance
l4_steps.input: Airflow DAG run metrics; Glue job logs; Redshift query performance insights
l4_steps.output: Real-time pipeline health dashboard; automated SLA breach alerts to PagerDuty
l4_steps.kpi: Pipeline SLA breach rate ≤0.5% per month; mean time to detect (MTTD) ≤5 min
l4_steps.pain_point: Airflow MWAA auto-scaling lags during IROP events when flight data ingestion volume spikes 3–5× baseline, causing cascading DAG failures and delayed operational reporting to the NOC

l4_steps.name: Manage Redshift cluster capacity and cost governance
l4_steps.input: Monthly Redshift usage report; query advisor recommendations
l4_steps.output: Rightsizing recommendation; reserved instance purchase plan; cluster scaling action
l4_steps.kpi: Redshift cost per TB processed ≤$25; month-over-month cost variance ≤10%; idle cluster time ≤5%
l4_steps.pain_point: Ad-hoc analyst queries with full table scans on unoptimised Redshift tables generate runaway costs; lack of workload management (WLM) queues allows single queries to consume entire cluster resources

l4_steps.name: Execute platform incident response and root-cause analysis
l4_steps.input: SLA breach alert from CloudWatch; user-reported data outage
l4_steps.output: Incident resolution; post-mortem report in Confluence; pipeline fix deployed via CI/CD
l4_steps.kpi: MTTR for P1 data outages ≤2 hours; post-mortem completed within 48 hours; recurrence rate ≤10% for resolved incidents
l4_steps.pain_point: Data platform incidents during irregular operations (when analytics are most needed by NOC and Revenue) cannot be deprioritised, but on-call rosters are understaffed relative to the criticality of the platform
